name: .env Editor
description: Edit dotenv files as a table while keeping comments, order and quoting; export .env.example
help: Parsing and saving run locally in Rust; files never leave your computer.
Comments, blank lines and unrecognizable lines are preserved as-is; variable order never changes and keys, values and inline comments are editable.
Values are shown escaped (\n, \", \\) following the rules used by most dotenv loaders.
The leading switch toggles the export prefix; saving rejects duplicate or invalid keys.
Exporting generates a matching .example file (.env → .env.example) with values cleared and comments kept.

state.drop: Drop a .env file or click to open

row.multiline: This value spans multiple lines in the file
row.duplicate: This key appears more than once

warn.invalidKey: Some keys are invalid (start with a letter or underscore; letters, digits, underscores and dots only) — fix them before saving
